integrity: Proof relies on exact infinite-dimensional weighted Cauchy coefficient identities, dyadic separated expansions and uniform limiting estimates; numerical diagnostics do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Root-exponential upper bound not proved optimal; explicit critical residue only for the Hilbert–Schmidt norm; no unproved extrapolation to other kernels or domains. Publication priority has residual risks from further structured-kernel literature.
title: Root-exponential compression and a critical Hilbert–Schmidt residue for differential Hilbert operators
